changes.was: 55 names (the sky130 BSIM4 sensitivity universe minus the base set and the zeroed temperature coefficients, restricted to names the card defines)
changes.reason: the card has DVT1W = 0 (inactive in the base box). The BSIM4 narrow-width short-channel term then divides by cosh(0) - 1 = 0, so any DVT0W > 0 has no DC solution: in the 4 K smoke, DVT0W = 0.01 gave non-convergent ngspice runs of 1.8-2 s with currents up to 590 A, and the B1 refit of t40_pmos_W1_L0p04_d392 had 110 of 116 simulations stopped by the timeout. A probe of all 55 candidates at both box edges and at a 1% step on 3 smoke starting cards found no other candidate without a DC solution

changes.now: each ngspice process is stopped after 10 s (cryoml.explore.i6_1_tudelft.TIMEOUT_S; I5-1 used 120 s); a stopped run gives NaN currents (the optimizer's penalty; a NaN in a scored card makes the device failed). Normal runs take 0.03 s. Rows record n_sim_timeout
